name: Starlink transfer business-logic flaw
summary: The Starlink token's transfer logic moves tokens out of the liquidity pair's own balance without a sync(), so the attacker collapsed the reserve and swapped a small holding out for the pair's WBNB.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
